title: Scalable Weak-to-Strong Verifier Hardening for Agent Environments
abstract: arXiv:2610.15924v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agent environments are essential for large language model (LLM) development. They use programmatic verifiers to turn complex outcomes into rewards. Verifiers can be attacked into awarding full credit to cheating agents without completing the intended task, causing inaccurate evaluation and misalignment in training. As agent environments scale in numbers and difficulty, so must the repairing of exploitable verifiers. To this end, we ask whether today's model with scaled compute can automatically harden agent environments to prevent potentially stronger future models from reward hacking. We introduce a scalable, fully automatic approach to weak-to-strong verifier hardening. It first sets up an isolated verifier sandbox that agents cannot directly modify, then uses a hacker-fixer loop to find and repair remaining verifier vulnerabilities.   We apply this loop to Terminal Bench, KernelBench, and SETA, substantially reducing attack success

translated_title: 面向智能体环境的可扩展弱到强验证器加固方法
translated_abstract: 智能体环境对于大语言模型（LLM）的发展至关重要。它们使用程序化验证器将复杂的结果转化为奖励。然而验证器可能遭受攻击，使作弊的智能体在未完成预期任务的情况下仍获得满分，从而导致评估不准确和训练中的目标错位。随着智能体环境在数量和难度上的扩展，对可被利用的验证器的修复工作也必须相应扩展。为此，我们探讨这样一个问题：当今配备大规模算力的模型能否自动加固智能体环境，以防止未来可能更强大的模型进行奖励作弊。我们提出了一种可扩展的、完全自动化的弱到强验证器加固方法。该方法首先建立一个智能体无法直接修改的隔离验证器沙箱，然后使用“攻击者-修复者”循环来发现并修复验证器中剩余的漏洞。我们将该循环应用于 Terminal Bench、KernelBench 和 SETA，大幅降低了攻击成功率。
tldr: 提出一种可扩展的全自动弱到强验证器加固方法，通过隔离沙箱与“攻击者-修复者”循环自动发现并修复智能体环境中验证器的漏洞，防止更强大的未来模型进行奖励作弊。
en_tdlr: Proposes a scalable, fully automatic weak-to-strong verifier hardening approach that uses an isolated verifier sandbox and a hacker-fixer loop to automatically find and repair verifier vulnerabilities in agent environments, preventing reward hacking by potentially stronger future models.
